known_facts: A good iron ingot is worth at least 10 coins. A steel one? At least 25.
I hear those bandits, led by Rook, have a new camp somewhere in the old ruins. Bad for business.
The Mindbloom Petal? Heard stories. Sounds like a fool's errand. You can't sell a myth. Now, this healing potion... this you can buy.
I travel a circuit of six villages, and I reach this one on the first day of every month.
Salt sells for triple here in winter, because the village never stocks enough of it.
I travel with two hired guards now, and they cost me more than the bandits ever did.
Elara trades me dried herbs for glass vials; it is the only honest trade in this village.
Baelor has not bought a single thing from me in nine years.
A healing potion costs 50 coins, and no, I will not haggle below 40.
The east road is the fastest way to the city and the most robbed; the south road adds four days but you keep your goods.
